task_title: Agent-driver mode: document and harden driving speclang from another coding agent
task_criteria: A new Agent Driver guide exists in docs and every command it documents exits 0 when run verbatim from a fresh clone; a full agent-driven loop is proven by a walkthrough transcript plus a generated-file listing with sizes: single-seed baseline prompt file written, cascade run, generated files on disk all non-empty, per-stage progress record produced.

items.criterion: A new Agent Driver guide exists in docs and every command it documents exits 0 when run verbatim from a fresh clone; a full agent-driven loop is proven by a walkthrough transcript plus a generated-file listing with sizes: single-seed baseline prompt file written, cascade run, generated files on disk all non-empty, per-stage progress record produced.
items.detail: docs/AGENT_DRIVER.md exists (381 lines, tracked: `git ls-files docs/AGENT_DRIVER.md`). Every §4 Runbook command run verbatim from repo root exits 0: `./bin/speclang --version` -> 1.0.0; `./bin/speclang status` -> "Specs: 452 (450 .spec.md + 2 .scl)"; `./bin/speclang validate scripts/agent-driver/seed.example.spec.md` -> "Validation Summary: 1 files / Passed: 1"; `./bin/speclang cascade -v scripts/agent-driver/seed.example.spec.md` -> "Generated: 2 files / Converged: Yes"; `node scripts/agent-driver/drive.mjs --seed ... --run-dir .speclang/agent-driver` -> "## SpecLang agent-driver run — PASS"; `--json | jq .ok` -> true; `./bin/speclangd status` -> "🔴 Daemon: Stopped"; §8 `./bin/speclang agent --trigger ... --provider openai --dry-run --json` -> exact JSON in doc; daemon start -d/status/stop all exit 0. Walkthrough transcript + generated-file listing with sizes in §4/§6 reproduced live: scripts/generated/greeting.ts 442 bytes (body 261), farewell.ts 300 bytes (body 119), both non-empty (`stat -c '%n %s'`). Per-stage progress record produced: .speclang/agent-driver/progress.{json,jsonl,md}, 5 stages all exit_code 0, ok:true. Tests: `npx vitest run tests/agent-driver/drive.test.ts` -> "Tests 6 passed (6)", exit 0; full guard `npx vitest run --passWithNoTests` -> "Tests 1995 passed | 58 skipped (2053)", exit 0. Caveat: "fresh clone" not literally reproducible here (dist/ is gitignored and must be built via `npm ci && npm run build`, which the doc states); verified on the built checkout.

items.criterion: The guide is reachable from the repository's documentation entry points (README / AGENTS.md / GETTING-STARTED / docs index), so an agent session told to use SpecLang can find it.
items.detail: docs/AGENT_DRIVER.md is an orphan with zero inbound links. `grep -rn "AGENT_DRIVER\|agent-driver\|Agent Driver" --include=*.md .` excluding the guide itself, node_modules and .speclang returns exactly one hit — scripts/agent-driver/seed.example.spec.md:2 (`id: "@agent-driver/baseline"`), a spec id, not a link. README.md:740-746 "Documentation" lists only docs/CONFIGURATION.md, docs/CASCADE_DEMO.md, specs/cascade-protocol.spec.md, specs/examples.spec.dir/hello-world.spec.md, .opencode/agents/; README.md:150-153 "API Reference" lists docs/API_REFERENCE.md. AGENTS.md:37-44 "Critical Specs (Read First)" lists NORTH_STAR/project.scl/core/headers/speclang only, and AGENTS.md:196-199 docs/ tree lists only NORTH_STAR.md. GETTING-STARTED.md:194,239 and CONTRIBUTING.md:144 mention docs/ generically. docs/MASTER_GUIDE.md:12,238, docs/OPERATIONS.md:353 and specs/docs.spec.dir/layers.md:170-173 ("See Also") do not reference it. `grep -rln "AGENT_DRIVER" .opencode/ specs/` -> empty; `grep -rn "drive.mjs" --include=*.md` outside the guide -> empty. The guide's own §9 "Related" links point outward only (../GETTING-STARTED.md, CONFIGURATION.md, troubleshooting.md). Commit 2e5bb76e touched only 4 files (docs/AGENT_DRIVER.md, scripts/agent-driver/drive.mjs, seed.example.spec.md, tests/agent-driver/drive.test.ts) — no README/AGENTS.md/index update. The guide's stated audience (docs/AGENT_DRIVER.md:3-5, "an agent session ... told to use SpecLang") therefore has no discoverable path to it.

items.criterion: The driver fails closed on the documented negative probes (banner-only artifact, vacuous 0/0 test convergence, missing seed, unknown flag, zero artifacts) rather than reporting success.
items.detail: drive.mjs fails closed on every documented probe: banner-only artifact -> exit 1, stderr "artifact carries only the generated banner, no body: /tmp/generated/hollow.ts" (drive.mjs:340-343); vacuous 0/0 test convergence -> exit 1, "test block(s) were generated but 0 tests executed — \"converged\" is vacuous" (drive.mjs:322-330); missing seed -> exit 2 ("seed not found"); unknown flag -> exit 2 (parseArgs fail()); zero-artifact case -> drive.mjs:305-309 pushes 'cascade reported no artifacts (exit 0 with zero files is a no-op, not a pass)'. Tests: `npx vitest run tests/agent-driver/drive.test.ts` -> "Tests 6 passed (6)", exit 0. Note (doc inaccuracy, not a driver defect): a probe seed with @kind:endpoint produced 1 artifact (196 bytes) and exited 0, contradicting docs/AGENT_DRIVER.md §5 rule 4 and §7 probe row 1 which claim non-code kinds are skipped.

items.criterion: The documented progress-record shape (progress.json / progress.jsonl / progress.md) matches what drive.mjs actually writes.
items.detail: docs/AGENT_DRIVER.md §3 table matches the live artifact: .speclang/agent-driver/progress.json keys = artifacts, finished_at, generated_dir, ok, reason, schema, seed, stages, started_at, warnings; stages[0] keys = command, detail, duration_ms, exit_code, name; artifacts[0] keys = absolute_path, body_bytes, bytes, exists, path, sha256. progress.jsonl has one JSON line per run (append-only, 2 lines after 2 runs); progress.md renders the stage and artifact Markdown tables. Matches drive.mjs finish()/renderMarkdown().

items.criterion: The documented artifact placement rule and byte sizes match reality, and the loop leaves the working tree clean (generated outputs gitignored).
items.detail: docs §2 "<artifacts> = <dir containing the seed>/../generated/" holds: seed scripts/agent-driver/seed.example.spec.md produced scripts/generated/{greeting,farewell}.ts (confirmed by `ls -la scripts/generated/` and the cascade's own "Generated: .../scripts/generated/greeting.ts" lines). Documented sizes 442/300 bytes and body_bytes 261/119 reproduce exactly (`stat -c '%n %s'` -> farewell.ts 300, greeting.ts 442; independent banner-strip recomputation -> 442/261 and 300/119). Banner text matches the documented "Auto-generated by SpecLang … DO NOT EDIT". Both paths are gitignored (.gitignore:2 `generated/`, .gitignore:38 `.speclang/`); `git status --porcelain` empty after the runs.
